value: AgentBoard 0.1.1 imports only paths via project_import: the desktop agent list_projects tool supplies local paths, while the widget SDK has no direct project-list method. Exclude cloud projects and remote hosts. Importing suggestions never connects or initializes trackers. Native card dragging, Markdown File admission, keyboard creation, editing, rollback, graph movement and dark/narrow UI were browser-host verified.

AgentBoard 0.1.2 uses namespaced board aliases pointing to host semantic tokens via the official OpenAI stylesheet; no custom light/dark palette remains. The preview optional themeControls supplies deliberately distinct light/dark tokens for live theme and dialog checks. Native desktop visual verification is still separate.

AgentBoard 0.1.3 automatically reads saved desktop paths through readDesktopProjects, a read-only compatibility adapter for CODEX_HOME/.codex-global-state.json local-projects.rootPaths with legacy-root fallback. Only normalized paths and basenames leave the reader; no scans or initialization. First use and project switching use a searchable inline list. Startup self-loads board_read without initial host results; fullscreen requests do not block data. project_import remains an optional fallback, not normal onboarding.

AgentBoard 0.1.4 reproduces and fixes persistent startup loading when MCP JSON text survives but structuredContent is missing. Decode both reply forms and validate snapshots before replacing Solid state. Handshake/read timeouts are 10/15 seconds with Retry loading; initial opener results are reused. Native read logs show success but omit payload, so browser repro does not establish the exact native cause.

Legacy roots use saved labels. Server and picker preserve order; connected/imported extras append without promoting current projects.
